title: Vehicle length, visibility, and arm’s-length trunk-use guidance
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes comments about vehicle length and visibility with unrelated how-to guidance about standing an arm’s length from the rear for kick-to-open operation, so the examples do not form a single cohesive product issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle’s length for exterior visibility and view the increased overall length and interior design favorably.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the manual is excessively long while still not being helpful.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mainly give procedural advice about standing an arm’s length away for kick-to-open use, with one unclear observation about long exterior length versus seemingly reduced interior space.

limitations: The topic cluster combines at least two unrelated subjects: opinions on vehicle length and visibility, and instructional text about kick-to-open operation.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in drawing a clear sentiment pattern.
The fragment about interior space versus vehicle length is ambiguous and does not clearly indicate a positive, negative, or mixed judgment.
